summary_for_children: Surah Ibrahim compares a good word to a good tree, and teaches that gratitude brings more blessings. It records Ibrahim's prayer for his family in a dry valley.
world_title: The Valley of the Good Tree
environment_concept: A valley where a good tree's roots are firm and its branches reach the sky, beside an uncultivated valley near a sacred House.
architecture_and_scenery: A great tree on a hill, a dry valley with a well, rivers and ships below, sun and moon overhead.

palette.lighting: Bright day with a clear sunset
palette.atmosphere: Dry heat in the valley, cool by the rivers

areas.name: The Good Tree
areas.description: A tree with deep roots and high branches.

areas.name: Uprooted Tree
areas.description: A dead tree lying loose on the ground.

areas.name: Uncultivated Valley
areas.description: A dry valley near the sacred House.

activities.name: Good words grow
activities.description: Choose kind words; each one makes the good tree grow.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Thankful stones
activities.description: Place a stone for each blessing you thank Allah for.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The narrator explains the parable carefully and reads Ibrahim's prayer from the Quran's text.
learning_objectives: Know Ibrahim prayed for his family

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
